subject: Startups
title: Culture as Competitive Moat
description: A quick win: understand Culture as Competitive Moat.

hook.text: You can copy a feature in weeks. You can copy a strategy in months.

buildup.text: Zappos built an e-commerce empire on customer service culture.

discovery.text: Tony Hsieh offered new Zappos hires $2,000 to quit after training. Only culture-aligned people stayed.

twist.text: Amazon bought Zappos for $1.2 billion—largely for the culture and the team, not just the revenue.

climax.text: Products can be commoditized. Technology can be replicated.

punchline.text: Culture is the moat that no competitor can cross.

quiz.question: What did Tony Hsieh offer new Zappos employees after training?
